title: Valid Subarrays With Exactly One Peak
summary: Mark peaks using the original array: an interior index exceeds both neighbors. Count inclusive subarrays [l,r] containing exactly one such marked index i, with i-l<=k and r-i<=k. Peak status is global, so a marked index can be at a subarray endpoint.
